title: Parse Name and Age
prompt: Implement `int parse_person(const char* line, char* name, int* age)`: parse `<name> <age>` from the line. Store the name (max 31 chars + terminator) and age through the out-parameters. Return 1 if both fields were read, 0 otherwise.

tests.name: valid line
tests.hint: int got = sscanf(line, "%31s %d", name, age); return got == 2;

tests.name: missing age fails
tests.code:
char name[32]; int age = -1;
CHECK_EQ(parse_person("Linh", name, &age), 0);
tests.hint: sscanf returns how many items it read — 1 here, so return 0.
